title: Microsoft Teams: near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes in messages
summary: The briefing passes: its controls, default, licensing and rollout information are supported by Microsoft's documentation and notice. The statement that QR images carry phishing links past text-based link checks is not established by the sources reviewed and should be narrowed.

claims.quote: Microsoft Teams will introduce near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes shared in messages.

claims.claim: QR codes in images can carry phishing links past text-based link checks.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Teams QR codes phishing bypass text based link checks detection. Read malicious URL protection, QR obscuring and Phishing trends and techniques. The latter describes moving interaction away from email scanning, not the claimed bypass of text-based checks.
claims.fix: Replace 'QR codes in images are a way to carry a phishing link past text-based link checks, and this change brings them under the same protection as typed URLs.' with 'This change brings destinations in QR codes under the same malicious URL protection as typed URLs.'
